Two years and 1,329 days after being charged with 115 financial rule violations, City has been found guilty of the majority of them. But the club found out privately, the league stayed silent, and the public only knows because The Athletic broke the story. City's own statement never confirmed the verdict, just that the "process remains ongoing" as they prepare to appeal.

SpaceX's mega rocket launched from South Texas early Monday and reached Earth orbit for the first time ever, according to TechCrunch. Right after stage separation, the upper stage lost one of its six Raptor engines. SpaceX first scrubbed the orbit attempt, then reversed course minutes later and kept pushing.

The original plan had Starship circling Earth six times over nine hours while dropping off 26 new Starlink satellites. It's still unclear if that plan changed. Meanwhile the Super Heavy booster nailed its cleanest simulated landing yet, a big step toward a fully reusable rocket.

Reaching orbit brings SpaceX closer to regular commercial missions and cheaper access to space, which could open doors for builders who never had a shot at the industry before.

Would cheaper rockets open space up to more builders, not just billionaires?

Tria Federal, headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, just landed a four-year deal to keep running community care support for the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). The work includes contract oversight, utilization management and building out new payment models for veteran care.

The deal almost didn't happen. Paramount had to out-compete Netflix for WBD, survive criticism from lawmakers and Hollywood talent over consolidation, and settle with 12 states that sued to block it over antitrust concerns. Part of that settlement forces Skydance to release at least 30 theatrical films in its first two years and spend $300 million more on US production than both companies spent last year combined. David Ellison now leads Skydance alongside Ynon Kreiz, former chairman and CEO of Mattel.

Now the stock photo giant is filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and going private, according to Fast Company.

The restructuring hands full control to the Getty family and Koch Equity Development, the investment arm of Koch, Inc., which is putting in up to $533 million. A planned merger with Shutterstock, announced back in January, fell apart before this deal came together. Haemanthus says it will test blood, urine and saliva at home using laser based technology called Raman Spectroscopy, different from Theranos's old approach. For years, runners between miles 20 and 21 looped around East 140th Street in Mott Haven, past a Western Beef and a 24-hour laundromat. Residents of the Patterson Houses, nearly 1,800 units of public housing, said the old route cut them off from the supermarket and other local businesses. Now, for the first time in 15 years, the course changes: runners stay on Alexander Avenue, then take East 141st Street, Third Avenue and East 138th Street to the Madison Avenue Bridge. Seven turns become five. More than 50,000 runners are expected, after a world-record 59,226 finishers last year. Before all that, the 53rd Village Halloween Parade steps off Saturday at 7pm from Canal Street.

The other side: New York Road Runners calls the changes minor adjustments, and sections of Bronx streets still close from 7am to 8:30pm Sunday.

The Brewers hit 154 homers in the regular season, 28th in MLB, but scored 832 runs, second in baseball, and won 103 games. In the Series, the teams combined for four homers.
